newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka says bodies of 60 soldiers found.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka says bodies of 60 soldiers found.

text.p: The Sri Lankan army has found the bodies of 60 soldiers who died in a pre-dawn attack by Tamil Tiger rebels on a key army-held northern town on Thursday, a military spokesman told Reuters.
The spokesman Brigadier Tissa Jayatunga said soldiers were still searching the Paranthan town area for more casualties.
He said soldiers destroyed several artillery pieces to prevent them from falling into the hands of Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam rebels who overran army positions in their assault.
The Sri Lankan defence ministry earlier said 500 rebels were killed or wounded in the fighting, which raged for most of the day.
